notes.title: Fixing Typos
notes.content:
- Fixed some minor language typos
- Added scroll wheel support for the menu
- Removed the Unity watermark

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
- We discovered a bug in world 6, level 3 where the draggable objects were not able to be interacted with. This change should fix this bug.
- Some levels had misaligned "click catchers", which help correct for slight misclicks.
